title: Speaking assessment rubric: content, delivery, response to questions
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Writing to argue and persuade; end of year
source: Written for english/y8 lesson 78 (Speaking assessment rubric: content, delivery, response to questions (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 78: Delivering the speech: presenting and responding. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Skill
How
rows: look at the camera, not the script
after the rhetorical question and before the final line
stress the key word in each sentence

parts.text: Look up at every full stop
Slow down for the final line

keywords.def: how a speech is spoken: pace, volume, tone
the formal English expected in public speaking

questions.q: Mark up your opening with pauses and stresses
Core: deliver your speech to the class (2 to 3 minutes) and answer one question
questions.a: Delivery and response assessed against the rubric

questions.q: Extend: give specific feedback here to three speakers
Stretch: reflect: what will you change next time you speak?
Someone asks, 'What if the elected leader is unfair?' Best response?
options: That's a fair concern; that is why leaders should be accountable and can be replaced.
questions.a: C) That's a fair concern; that is why leaders should be accountable and can be replaced.. Acknowledging the concern and answering with a reason shows confidence and fairness.
